## What this lands

One session's output on token-cost optimisation: the research, the backlog work it surfaced, three rulings recorded, and one new `check:health` gate that the session's own failure mode motivated.

### 1. Research (`reports/`, `/research/`)

- `we:reports/2026-09-06-token-optimisation-research.md` — a wide survey of LLM token-cost optimisation (prompt caching economics, prefix stability, the tools→system→messages invalidation cascade, context-shaping techniques).
- It carries a **Scope limit** section, added after the skeptic pass found the report was applying **per-token API economics to a subscription-funded system**. This repo's agent spawns run on the operator's subscription (`#agent-runner-cli-backend`); recorded `costUsd` is a rate-table derivation, not money billed. The scarce resource is the **usage window**. That correction is load-bearing for everything downstream and is stated at the top of the report rather than buried.
- Exposed as a `/research/` topic (`we:src/_data/researchTopics/token-optimisation-research.json` + its `.njk` description), so it is not a hidden report. `npm run gen:inventory` re-ran; the `AGENTS.md` inventory line moves 306 → 307 topics.
- `we:reports/2026-09-06-backlog-split-analysis.md` (rev 3) and `we:reports/2026-09-06-backlog-consolidation-analysis.md` — the slicing and consolidation passes. The split analysis records **the retractions**, including an auto-resolve hazard caught before it shipped (see below).

### 2. Backlog capture (9 new items)

`xblcmkc`, `x6z6z2j`, `xzdzg3j`, `x2xrboe`, `x5c8zep`, `xbwup67`, `xjktyol`, `xarvjgf`, `xayr3dc`.

### 3. Three rulings recorded

- **#2201** — a region recipe declares a **mid-marker** the region walk treats as a parse-time delimiter, splitting the body into a named-program map. Build slice carved as `xjktyol`.
- **#3123** — fork **dissolved**: rollup levels are an **open-set dimension configured per project**, not a fixed enum. We ship presets and pick our own by merit (`#config-extends-platform-default`). Carved as `xarvjgf` (the dimension) + `xayr3dc` (the preset flavors).
- **`x2xrboe`** — **depth only**: care dials `rounds` / `lenses` / `jurorsPerLens`; a care band may not reach model or effort. Amended at ratification: **strength is operator-settable, never care-derived**. Carved as `xbwup67` (give `effort` the operator control-flag treatment `model` already has).

### 4. `check:health` G8 — a prepared decision may not lean on an unruled sibling

`we:scripts/audit-backlog-health.mjs` gains `forkLeansOnUnruled`, a pure exported function: a **prepared, still-open** `decision` whose `## Fork` prose cites a still-**open** sibling `decision` with **no `blockedBy` edge** to it. The bold default rests on a premise nobody has ratified while the DAG stays silent, so readiness ranks the dependent card ahead of its own ground.

- Scoped to `## Fork` sections deliberately — a citation under *Context* is background, not the default leaning on it.
- Distinct from **G1**, which keys on prerequisite *verbs*: a fork can lean on an unruled sibling without ever saying "blocked on", which is exactly how it escapes G1.
- CANDIDATE-grade like G3/G4/G5 — confirm at claim, then either add the edge or re-ground the default.
- Documented in `we:docs/agent/backlog-workflow.md` alongside the other gates.

Built only after it was shown to catch the real case (#2249 → #2209) at low noise: **9 hits** across 3,495 items. It also surfaced two mutually circular premise pairs.

A **G9** prototype was written and deliberately **not shipped** — it "caught" #2224 only via the universal `decision` tag, which is theatre, not a signal.

### 5. The pre-presentation currency step

`we:skills-src/next-backlog-item/SKILL.md` gains a mandatory step: before presenting a prepared decision, re-verify it is still current. This exists because three decisions were presented in-session without that check. G8 is the deterministic half; this is the procedural half.

## Verification

- `npm run check:standards` — **0 errors** (1,599 warnings, all pre-existing repo-wide).
- `npx vitest run` — **409 files, 10,764 passed / 7 skipped, 0 failed**.
- `we:scripts/__tests__/audit-backlog-health.test.mjs` — 10/10, of which 5 are new G8 cases.
- **Mutation-tested**, three guarantees separately: removing the `blockedBy` exemption, removing the `## Fork` section scoping (isolated to G8's own line), and removing the open-decision filter each **redden a named test**. No decorative assertions.
- `origin/main` merged in; no conflicts.

## Known limits, stated rather than papered over

- **The producer path was bypassed.** This host has no `gh` credential, so `run.mjs open-pr` reports `unrun`. The **decision** was still made by the operation: `scoreEscalation` over the cumulative `merge-base(origin/main, HEAD)…HEAD` basis returns `escalate: true`, `humanRequired: false` (blast-radius on the three `scripts/`/`skills-src/` files, plus size at 1,874 ≥ 400 lines) → `producerReviewLabel` = **`review:pending`**, applied by hand at open. Only the execution moved. Per #3267 this also means the `authored-by-actor` stamp is **absent** — `we:scripts/review-set-label.mjs`'s single home was not in play, so no independence guard ran at open.
- **`humanRequired` is false on a verified basis, not an assumption**: `isPolicySpecPath` / `isPolicyCorePath` / `isTrustChainPath` return **0 hits** across all 25 changed files, `we:docs/agent/platform-decisions.md` is untouched, and the diff edits no `@principle`/`@invariant` marker. The two-PR rule (`#principle-and-impl-two-pr`) is therefore not triggered.
- **The branch is `claude/…`, not `lane/*`.** The #1934 carve-out wants a lane ref and `open-pr` refuses this one by name. The session pins this branch and forbids pushing elsewhere without explicit permission, so the PR is opened from it.
- **Three status splices are still owed** and need a lane clone the guard will accept: `status: resolved` on **#2201** and **`x2xrboe`**, plus `preparedDate` on **`x2xrboe`**. The rulings are recorded in the card bodies; only the frontmatter splice is outstanding.
- **An auto-resolve hazard was caught, not shipped.** `planEpicResolveOnLand` would have silently closed **#3006** when a child landed — the first grep missed the wiring because `we:scripts/pr-watch.mjs` calls a wrapper, `resolveEpicOnLand`. Defused by wiring `#3006 blockedBy: ["x2xrboe"]` and parenting no new stories to it, so it stays childless.
- **`xzdzg3j`'s justification is weaker than its card reads** — part of it rested on behaviour that is already ratified. Flagged on the card rather than silently corrected.

## The recurring defect in this changeset, named for the reviewer

**Reading a producer's signature and inferring the consumer's behaviour** — six occurrences in one session, each caught only by opening the call sites. Attack any claim in these reports or cards that describes what a function's *callers* do.
